name: MM Proposition I
use: Perfect capital markets: firm value does not depend on capital structure.
pitfall: Equity value = V_U − D, not the PV of equity cash flows at r_U.

name: Average cost stays unchanged
formula: E/(E + D) × r_E + D/(E + D) × r_D = r_U
use: Check any levered return calculation against the unlevered cost.

name: Homemade leverage
formula:
Replicate x% of levered equity:
buy x% of U, borrow x% of D
use: Arbitrage argument behind MM I (investors borrow at the firm's rate).
